findings.title: Desktop Tauri Rust dependency tree is not advisory-scanned by cargo audit
findings.summary: cargo audit runs only against runtime/Cargo.lock in both the local security-hardening gate and CI; the shipped desktop bridge's Rust dependency graph (desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock) is license-enumerated but never checked for RUSTSEC advisories.

locations.role: CI advisory audit — runtime-only cargo audit

evidence.label: cargo audit scope
evidence.explanation: Both cargo audit invocations target only runtime/Cargo.lock; no invocation references desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock.
evidence.excerpt: ci.yml:115 cargo audit --file runtime/Cargo.lock; test_security_hardening.sh:9 cargo audit --file runtime/Cargo.lock

evidence.label: desktop tree is distinct and pinned
evidence.explanation: desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock is a separate checksum-pinned graph (tauri 2.11.5 etc.) that only cargo about (licenses), not cargo audit (advisories), processes.
